verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say it pays employees and contractors around the world in a single system, without waiting on transfers or conversion, which covers the global contractor payment core. Local-currency payout is only implied by the 'no conversion' wording; the currency conversion it explicitly documents is for comparing compensation in reports. The only compliance claim is a generic 'compliance in one system' line, with nothing on contractor contracts. Missing for 10: explicit local-currency contractor payouts, compliant contractor contract generation or classification, independent or hands-on corroboration of international contractor payments.
